item.title: Couple rejects $131,000 offer for data center power line on their property
item.description: Jerry Zelenka has turned down American Transmission Company's proposal to place a power line on his property, citing worries over tree removal and the demolition of numerous buildings. He is particularly troubled by the level of compensation offered and the potential threat of eminent domain. Meanwhile, legal disputes from neighboring landowners about the project's validity persist.

item.title: Washington golf course could lose up to 529 trees as lawsuit challenges redesign
item.description: The National Park Service has proposed the removal of 529 trees at East Potomac Golf Links as part of their maintenance strategy, sparking legal disputes. Park proponents are worried about how this redevelopment might affect local recreation. Concerns also revolve around preserving the historic landscape and transparency about future developments. Despite these discussions, the golf course remains operational while plans evolve.

item.title: 'West Indies, 'West Indies, you can never take them lightly': Shreyas Iyer after India take 2-1 leadyou can never take them lightly': Shreyas Iyer after India take 2-1 lead
item.description: India captain Shreyas Iyer praised his bowlers for their confident approach and clear plans after the team defeated the West Indies by 14 runs in the third T20I at Holkar Stadium on Sunday. The victory gave India a 2-1 lead in the five-match series. India successfully defended a target of 224, restricting the West Indies to 209/7. Arshdeep Singh took three wickets, while Naman Dhir picked up two scalps to help India stop the visitors from completing another successful chase.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Taylor Swift’s $4m Nashville education centre now showcases local student art
item.description: In 2012, Taylor Swift donated $4 million to create an education center at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. This center focuses on engaging children and families with the history of country music. Currently, it hosts an exhibition called Connection featuring works by students and artists from Friends Life Community. Participants learn letterpress printing techniques and create their own unique posters.

item.title: After investing $65B in OpenAl, Japan's richest man seeks $100B for other AI projects
item.description: Masayoshi Son seeks to amass $100 billion from Gulf investors for a new fund dedicated to investing in traditional businesses. This venture aims to target companies that are behind in automation, leveraging AI to improve their operations. Unlike SoftBank's previous focus on early-stage tech startups, this initiative caters to established firms.

item.title: Kathi Kebab Roll vs Frankie vs Wrap: What is the difference?
item.description: Kathi rolls, hailing from the vibrant streets of Kolkata, showcase a delectable combination of kebabs enveloped in flaky paratha. In contrast, Mumbai's Frankies feature scrumptious, spiced fillings wrapped in soft roti or paratha, making them uniquely flavorful. Wraps, on the other hand, embody versatility, utilizing various flatbreads to accommodate an array of fillings and sauces.

item.title: Iran calls US response to seven-day Hormuz proposal ‘insufficient’
item.description: Iran’s Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei stated that the US response was insufficient to Iran's conditions. Tehran proposed a seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear negotiations. Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi indicated that the negotiations are ongoing, with messages exchanged through mediators. As tensions rise, Washington reportedly prepares military options against Iran amid ongoing discussions.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Tanker carrying 11 Indians hit by drone off Oman coast, 2 crew members missing
item.description: The tanker MT PETRO DOLPHIN faced an assault while anchored off the coast of Sohar, Oman, with 11 Indian crew aboard. While nine crew members were successfully rescued, two remain unaccounted for. Local Coast Guard authorities have mobilized search-and-rescue operations, with ongoing efforts to find the missing crew members. Minister Sarbananda Sonowal has pledged full support for the rescue efforts underway.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: 'Next PM Vijay 2029’: Placards trigger brief stir at PM Modi event in Chennai
item.description: During a government event in Chennai, PM Modi and CM Vijay inaugurated significant projects worth approximately Rs 13,000 crore. The gathering was briefly disrupted when supporters displayed placards promoting Vijay as the next Prime Minister. PM Modi emphasized the importance of cooperative federalism and vowed to continue supporting Tamil Nadu's development. Vijay called for the release of central funds and sought approval for additional infrastructure projects.

item.title: 'Give us date within 24hrs or we will announce our own protest call': CJP to Police
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party leaders, including Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das, will visit Parliamentary Street Police Station to request protest permission. Following recent detentions of over 7,000 protesters, they are urging a date for Jantar Mantar. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has also called for a protest march to the Supreme Court regarding electoral roll issues. The Supreme Court emphasized the importance of access to justice and citizens' rights.
item.dc:creator: VRITI JAIN

item.title: 'Good for Americans': US official defends Russia diesel deal, cites 'legal authority'
item.description: Defending the diesel supply agreement with Russia, Scott Bessent highlights the Trump administration's strategy to alleviate fuel prices. The deal initiates with more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel heading from Russia, with an additional 3 million tonnes expected shortly. The US Treasury Secretary assures that the decision rests on legal foundations, with promising implications for both American consumers and the international trading landscape.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: ‘Our seas, our land’: Sri Lanka assures India against hostile acts from its territory
item.description: Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has stressed that his country will not allow its territory for hostile actions. He reiterated the commitment to a non-aligned foreign policy amid the US-Iran conflict and rejected military requests from both sides. Dissanayake emphasized humanitarian assistance will be provided if needed. Security cooperation with India was also reaffirmed during a recent meeting with Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 'Cops knew I'd lost my grandma, yet insisted I sign arrest papers': CJP's Dipke
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke, a Cockroach Janta Party activist, has accused Delhi Police of unjust treatment in custody. He claims police denied him access to his phone and lawyers, especially after learning about his grandmother's death. Dipke was instructed to contact his parents at an inappropriate hour regarding his arrest. The Delhi Police stated they offered assistance and informed him about his grandmother's passing.

item.title: Zelenskyy says ready to hold Ukraine elections if Russia offers 60-day ceasefire
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky suggested organizing elections if a 60-day ceasefire with Russia is established. He reacted to criticisms from Donald Trump regarding his leadership and military actions. Zelensky emphasized that the decision of Ukraine's leadership lies with its people, not external figures. He acknowledged an announcement of an energy ceasefire, but stated it was news to him.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Gold, silver prices next week: What investors should watch amid global uncertainty
item.description: Gold and silver prices are anticipated to remain range-bound with modest support from rupee fluctuations. Investors will focus on upcoming inflation data from India, China, and the US. Additionally, trade data from China and Federal Reserve officials' speeches will be monitored closely. Geopolitical tensions, particularly involving the US and Iran, may also impact market sentiment. Overall, significant factors influencing bullion prices include currency movements and investment demand.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Rupee relief, higher hedging costs: What RBI’s new forex rules mean
item.description: Reserve Bank of India has introduced new measures aimed at stabilizing the Indian rupee against the dollar. These changes include tighter restrictions on foreign exchange derivatives and new reserve requirements for banks. Analysts expect these measures to ease rupee depreciation and lower speculative dollar demand temporarily. However, external factors like high crude oil prices may continue influencing the currency's stability.
